# Chord a Day Journey

> Learn 30 essential guitar chords in 30 days through short, daily micro-lessons designed for absolute beginners.

The site delivers one chord per day with diagrams, audio, common-mistake tips, and short practical exercises (5–10 min). Available in PT-BR and EN-US.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Daily chord overview, progress tracking, and lesson selector.
- [Intro Lesson](/intro): Guitar anatomy, finger naming, and posture basics for absolute beginners.
- [Daily Lesson](/lesson/1): One chord per day with diagram, exercise, and tip (replace `1` with day 1–30).
- [Rhythm Module](/RythmModule/rythm): Strumming patterns, finger notation, and metronome practice.
- [Bonus Lesson](/bonus): Extra material after completing the 30-day journey.
- [Slideshow](/slideshow): Visual review of all chords learned.
